content.short: DeFi hub for finding yield strategies, prediction markets and trades, with a unified portfolio.
content.description: Odyssey gathers opportunities from across DeFi into one app. Its Yieldr section ranks strategies such as Pendle PT loops on Morpho and Aave positions by APY, Predictr shows live prediction markets on sports, politics and the economy, and Tradr and Loopr cover trading and leverage. Everything shows up on one portfolio page, and deposits earn points toward rewards.
content.meta: Odyssey collects DeFi yield strategies, prediction markets and trading into one app with a single portfolio view.
content.pageTitle: Odyssey - DeFi Dapps - Lancers Web3 Explorer
